newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB says to cut standard mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB says to cut standard mortgage rate.

text.p: The National Australia Bank (NAB) said on Friday it had decided to cut its standard variable home loan rate to 7.55 percent from 8.25 percent.
The new rate matches an aggressive new benchmark in the hotly contested home loan market set by the Commonwealth Bank of Australia Ltd on Wednesday.
NAB spokesman David Upton told Reuters the new rate would be available to both owner-occupiers and investors.
It would be effective for new customers on Monday, February 17, and for existing customers on April 7, he said.
